title: ID0419067-DC/Si-D/EE-[rClCo6]- Vändra DC2 stuck in preparing and water inside the plug.
description:
Location:
Alexela Vändra, Estonia
Reported behaviour/issue:
After commissioning and installation, DC2 was giving TempSensor error and after wiring check, TempSensor error was gone but socket remained stuck in “preparation”. Voltage between ground and CP was <12VDC. Later we found out there is water inside the plug.
Solution:
CCS2 cable replacement.
